ÉLAN / SCHOOL COLLABORATION

Build Élan
with us.

Bring your students, your ideas and a clear sense of what your school can contribute. Participation and organising collaboration are separate conversations.

A SHARED RESPONSIBILITY

A meaningful role.
A clear agreement.

01

One point of contact.

Nominate a coordinator to discuss student participation, communication and the scope of your school’s involvement.

02

A contribution that fits.

Tell us where you can help: outreach, faculty coordination, logistics, venue support or student leadership. Responsibilities are agreed with the organising team.

03

Recognition, agreed together.

Website credit, event visibility and other benefits need to match the agreed contribution. These are discussed individually rather than promised in advance.

04

Student welfare comes first.

Supervision, conduct, consent and emergency communication need clear responsibilities before participation is confirmed.

BEGIN WITH YOUR SCHOOL

Let’s find the right
way to work together.
